init.title: BrewCreator devices
init.description: Add a device to your BrewCreator account, or remove one. You still need brewcreator.com to create the account.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Which kind of device do you want to add?

add_by_serial_number.title: Add a Ferminator or Graviator
add_by_serial_number.description: Switch the device on and connect it to Wi-Fi first. Its serial number is printed with the QR code: on a Ferminator on the back of the cooling/heating unit, above the heat sink, and on a Graviator on the cylinder, opposite the logo.

data_description.serial_number: Letters and digits in the form AB12-CD3-EF4, with or without dashes.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the device type, and for a Graviator its colour, such as Graviator Red.

graviator_color.title: Graviator colour
graviator_color.description: The serial number is a Graviator. Which colour is it?

data_description.color: Only colours no other Graviator has are offered.

add_tilt.title: Add a Tilt
add_tilt.description: A Tilt has no serial number. It reports through a Ferminator: select its colour on the Ferminator, and link it with the Ferminator's Hydrometer select once it is added.

data_description.color: Only colours no other Tilt has are offered.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to Tilt and the colour, such as Tilt Orange.

remove_device.title: Remove a device
remove_device.description: Which device do you want to remove from your BrewCreator account?

remove_confirm.title: Remove {name}?
remove_confirm.description: {name} ({type}) will be removed from your BrewCreator account, and its device and entities from Home Assistant. If it is linked, it is unlinked first. Its brew history in BrewCreator may be lost. To use it again, add it again.

error.invalid_serial_number: Enter the serial number as printed, such as AB12-CD3-EF4.
error.already_in_account: This device is already in your BrewCreator account.
error.serial_number_not_found: BrewCreator doesn't know this serial number. Check it, and that the device is switched on and connected to Wi-Fi.
error.already_registered: This device is already registered in BrewCreator, possibly in another account. Remove it there first.
error.name_too_long: The name can be at most 128 characters.
error.unsupported_type: This serial number belongs to a {type}, which this integration doesn't support.
error.color_taken: Another device has taken this colour meanwhile. Choose another one.

abort.not_loaded: The BrewCreator integration isn't running. Fix its setup first, then try again.
abort.no_free_tilt_color: Every Tilt colour is already taken. Remove a Tilt first.
abort.no_free_graviator_color: Every Graviator colour is already taken. Remove a Graviator first.
abort.no_devices: There are no devices in your BrewCreator account.
abort.device_added: Added {name}. Its entities appear in a moment.
abort.device_removed: Removed {name} from BrewCreator and Home Assistant.
abort.already_removed: The device is no longer in your BrewCreator account.

unsupported_equipment.title: Unsupported BrewCreator device: {type}
unsupported_equipment.description: The BrewCreator account has device(s) of type "{type}" ({names}) that this integration does not support yet. Other devices keep working. Please open an issue and attach the integration's diagnostics download so support can be added.

set_batch_info.name: Set batch info
set_batch_info.description: Changes the batch info of a Ferminator, or of a Graviator not linked to one, in BrewCreator, such as its name, gravities and whether the brew is started. Only the fields you give or clear are changed. Give or clear at least one.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Ferminator, or the Graviator not linked to a Ferminator, whose batch to change.

beer_style.name: Beer style
beer_style.description: Style of the beer, such as IPA or Scottish Export.

original_gravity.name: Original gravity
original_gravity.description: Specific gravity before fermentation, from 0.980 to 1.999. Must be above the final gravity.

final_gravity.name: Final gravity
final_gravity.description: Expected or measured specific gravity after fermentation, from 0.980 to 1.999. Must be below the original gravity.

ebc.name: EBC
ebc.description: Colour of the beer in EBC, a whole number of at least 1.

ibu.name: IBU
ibu.description: Bitterness in IBU, a whole number of at least 1.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Batch volume in litres, a whole number of at least 1.

started.name: Started
started.description: Start (true) or stop (false) the brew. BrewCreator logs the brew's readings while it is started.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Fields to clear, so they have no value. A field can't be both given and cleared.

no_batch_info.message: Device {device_id} is not a Ferminator or Graviator of a loaded BrewCreator integration.

linked_to_ferminator.message: {name} is linked to {ferminator}. Change the batch info on the Ferminator.

control_failed.message: Failed to change the temperature control of {name} in BrewCreator: {error}

final_gravity_not_below_original.message: The final gravity ({fg}) must be below the original gravity ({og}). Give both to change them together.

set_and_cleared.message: Can't both give and clear {fields}. Give a field a value or clear it.

update_failed.message: Failed to update the batch info of {name} in BrewCreator: {error}

link_failed.message: Failed to change the hydrometer linked to {name} in BrewCreator: {error}
